# @wearables-ui-toolkit/mrbd

React component library for UI Toolkit for Meta Ray-Ban Display.

## Install

```sh
npm install @wearables-ui-toolkit/mrbd@latest
```

- [Repository](https://github.com/facebook/meta-ray-ban-display-ui-toolkit-web)
